notes: *it* at t007 is left `added` because its referent is the passover, not the place the resumptive `בּוֹ` points at; rule 44 forbids folding an unlicensed object pronoun into the verb.
The resumptive `בּוֹ` is marked as two `unrepresented` units (preposition and suffix) because the ASV writes only *which* for the relative clause and no fused pronominal adverb (rule 22).
